prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. THREE rows. TOP MANO adult female mine shift leader, stocky with tied dark hair under brown cloth cap, dull ochre work tunic and charcoal trousers, small UNLIT medieval enclosed hand lantern held low. MIDDLE APE adult male ventilation maintainer, greying hair and close beard, faded blue-grey tunic, leather belt with modest ordinary wood-handled tool, empty hands. BOTTOM XIJIE adult female independent mine-section inspector, dark short braid, muted olive tunic and brown short apron, a small wooden measuring rod held lowered. No modern hardhats, gasmasks, uniforms, powered gear, glowing safety lamps or certified safe reopening.
